# Unity Project Brain

> Open-source AI context engine for Unity projects. It combines GitNexus code
> intelligence, Unity GUID/fileID scene and prefab graphs, optional Roslyn
> symbols, runtime evidence, Git history, and read-only MCP/Context API
> surfaces for AI coding agents.

Canonical repository:
https://github.com/orange91pku/unity-ai-project-brain

License:
Apache-2.0 for Project Brain source. The pinned GitNexus dependency has
separate PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 terms; see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.

## Start here

- README.md: product overview, capabilities, and quick start.
- AGENTS.md: AI-agent operating rules, authority model, and verification.
- docs/GETTING_STARTED.md: installation and first project configuration.
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md: components, trust boundaries, and data flow.
- docs/EXTENSIONS.md: stable extension contracts.
- docs/UNITY_CLI.md: advisory Unity CLI integration.
- SECURITY.md: safe defaults and vulnerability reporting.

## Machine-readable contracts

- schemas/project-brain-config.schema.json
- schemas/change-envelope.schema.json
- schemas/roslyn-symbol-catalog.schema.json
- schemas/roslyn-unity-identity-bridge.schema.json
- schemas/runtime-evidence.schema.json
- schemas/git-history-evidence.schema.json
- schemas/unified-context-response.schema.json

## Primary commands

```text
pnpm run doctor -- --project <name>
pnpm run analyze -- --project <name>
pnpm run status -- --project <name>
pnpm run print-mcp -- --project <name>
python -m project_brain.unity_graph --help
python -m project_brain.context_api --help
pnpm run verify
```

Project Brain is read-only. It does not rename code, rewrite Unity serialized
files, replace art, or expose source mutation endpoints.
